reason: A CLI and DSH plugin for migrating supported skills, commands, agents, instructions, and MCP configuration from Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode into DeepSeek Harness, with dry-run and explicit apply modes.

summaries.zh: 用于将 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 中受支持的技能、命令、代理、指令和 MCP 配置迁移到 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: A CLI and DSH plugin that migrates supported skills, commands, agents, instructions, and MCP configuration from Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode into DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode configuration and skill files
Performs dry-run previews of migration changes
Writes migrated files and configuration when explicitly applied
Creates symlinks or copies for migrated skills
Creates backups and records migration manifests
Restores the newest recorded patch backup
